name: Quick Aid HELD-OUT set 3 (fresh, written after set 2 was used to improve the rules)
labelling_policy: Same policy as symptom_cases.json. Written after the rules were improved in response to symptom_holdout2.json, deliberately using none of its wording. Run ONCE; no rule is changed in response to these results (see HOLDOUT3_RESULT.md).
limitations: Written by the same developers, not clinician-validated, small. Includes Hindi (Devanagari), Kannada (Kannada script) and Marathi (Devanagari) cases as well as fresh Hindi/Kannada transliterations, several deliberate misspellings to test typo tolerance, and indirect/colloquial phrasing (including a British-slang overdose description and a third-person-reported self-harm case) designed to need the combination-signal and typo-tolerance detection layers rather than a single matching phrase.
